description: Reissue Codex inline-dispatch safety on a distinct patch version so existing 0.6.16 projects receive the update
changelog:
**Codex dispatch safety:**
- Reissues the inline-dispatch default as `0.6.17` so projects already stamped `0.6.16` do not treat the update as a no-op.
- `codex.dispatch_mode` defaults to `inline`, so the main Codex session implements and checks work itself unless a project explicitly opts into Trellis sub-agent dispatch.
- Set `codex.dispatch_mode: auto` in `.trellis/config.yaml` to keep Trellis-managed Codex sub-agent dispatch. The legacy `sub-agent` value remains an alias for `auto`.
- New Codex tasks no longer seed implement/check JSONL files in the default inline mode. Invalid dispatch values fail closed to inline mode.
notes: Upgrade both Ecochain Trellis packages to 0.6.17, run `trellis update` in each project, then start a new Codex session. No `--migrate` flag is required.
